qualifier: restraint of apoptotic and necroptotic death
name: TNFR1 signaling restraining apoptotic and necroptotic death
rationale: All members concern TNFR1 signaling and its linear-ubiquitin control; unlike the NF-kappaB-centred confusables, the theme adds negative regulation of extrinsic apoptosis, necroptosis and TNF signaling.

qualifier: dental tissues and ectopic calcification disorders
name: Dental mineralization and phosphate-linked ectopic calcification
rationale: Members cover tooth/enamel/dentin formation, phosphate transport and calcification diseases (PXE, IBGC1); the dental and mineralization focus separates it from bicarbonate, Na/Pi cotransporter and PTH-phosphate confusables.

qualifier: nephron bodies plus nephric duct and ureter
name: Nephron and nephric duct-ureter morphogenesis
rationale: Members are early nephron (comma/S-shaped body, tubule) morphogenesis plus mesonephric duct, ureteric bud and ureter development, the duct-ureter arm being what the tubule-segment confusables lack.

qualifier: BER repair synthesis and direct alkylation reversal
name: Base excision repair synthesis and alkylation damage reversal
rationale: Members combine BER gap-filling (POLB/PCNA long patch, single-nucleotide) with ALKBH2/3 and MGMT alkylation reversal, a pairing that separates it from TET/TDG demethylation and glycosylase-recognition confusables.

qualifier: fibronectin matrix, ILK complex, Rho-ROCK/PAK stress fibres
name: Integrin-fibronectin adhesion driving Rho-ROCK stress fiber remodeling
rationale: Members span integrin/syndecan matrix adhesion, focal-adhesion ILK complex and Rho-ROCK/PAK stress-fiber cytoskeletal remodeling, versus confusables centred on MET signaling, platelets, cell spreading or SRF targets.

name: Type I interferon-stimulated antiviral gene signature
rationale: Members are IFN-alpha/type I IFN response signatures (OAS, IRF2 targets, IP-10, cytosolic DNA sensing), distinguishing them from ISG15, dengue and RIG-I/IRF3 induction confusables.

core: Oxidative and hypoxic stress-induced cell death
name: Regulation of oxidative and hypoxic stress-induced apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate H2O2-, oxidative- and hypoxia-induced intrinsic apoptosis and mitochondrial depolarization, unlike confusables on respiration control, ferroptosis or MOMP.

qualifier: erythrocyte gas exchange and iron-export disorders
name: Iron and heme transport with erythrocyte gas exchange
rationale: Members cover iron uptake/export (transferrin, ferroportin, ceruloplasmin), heme scavenging and erythrocyte O2/CO2/NO transport, distinct from heme biosynthesis, cadmium and membrane-transport confusables.

qualifier: mtDNA replication through translation plus tRNA processing
name: Mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription, translation and tRNA processing
rationale: Members span mtDNA replication/repair, mitochondrial transcription, RNA processing, ribosome assembly and translation plus tRNA processing, whereas confusables centre on tRNA aminoacylation and RNA modification.

name: Chromatin silencing by CHD-NuRD remodelers and retroelement repressors
rationale: Members include CHD/NuRD/ChAHP remodelers, HDAC and MECP2-NCoR repression, KRAB-ZFP/HUSH retroelement silencing and X inactivation, versus confusables dominated by BAF assembly and histone methylation/acetylation.

name: IRF3-driven interferon-beta induction and cGAS-STING regulation
rationale: Members concern IRF3-mediated type I IFN induction and IFN-beta production/response with cGAS-STING control, unlike RIG-I/MDA5 sensing or IFN-alpha response confusables.

name: UDP-sugar synthesis and transport for N-glycan processing
rationale: Members cover UDP-GlcNAc/glucose/glucuronate synthesis, SLC35 nucleotide-sugar transport and N-glycan trimming, distinct from sialic acid/GPI, dolichol-ALG CDG and O-glycan/antennae confusables.

name: Coronavirus replicase translation and host translation modulation
rationale: Members concern SARS-CoV replicase translation/maturation, ribosomal frameshifting and host translation control, versus confusables on viral genome replication, capping and influenza RNA synthesis.

core: ER-Golgi lipid and lipidated protein traffic
name: Golgi phospholipid transfer and Wnt/Rab protein lipidation
rationale: Members combine ER-Golgi PI/PC transfer with Wnt palmitoleoylation/secretion and Rab geranylgeranylation, unlike glycolipid transport, RAS processing or vesicle-traffic confusables.

name: Cobalamin intestinal absorption and systemic transport
rationale: All members concern B12 uptake (intrinsic factor, cubam), transcobalamin and lysosomal export, whereas confusables are intracellular cobalamin metabolism or other B vitamins.

name: ER-to-cytosol protein retrotranslocation and ER exit regulation
rationale: Members concern regulation of protein exit from the ER and ER-to-cytosol retrograde transport, separate from ERAD degradation, SRP targeting and COPII/COPI vesicle confusables.

name: Chain-specific deubiquitination by USP and OTU proteases
rationale: Members are USP/OTU deubiquitinases removing K48/K11 chains and limiting K63 ubiquitination, unlike UCH, ubiquitin chain synthesis and NF-kappaB confusables.

qualifier: cobalamin absorption with thiamine and riboflavin
name: Cobalamin absorption and thiamine-riboflavin transport and metabolism
rationale: Members cover cobalamin absorption/transport together with thiamine and riboflavin transport and metabolism, versus confusables limited to intracellular cobalamin metabolism or vitamin E.

name: Lysine methylation, hydroxylation and translation-factor residue modification
rationale: Members are lysine/arginine methylation, histone demethylation, hydroxylation and specialised translation-machinery modifications, distinct from translation termination, polyamine and initiation confusables.

name: Cadherin transcription and TGF-beta-driven mesenchymal progenitor control
rationale: Members combine cadherin gene regulation (CDH1/11/19), TGF-beta/BMP/Wnt signaling and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation/differentiation, versus osteoblast- and TGFBR3-centred confusables.

name: Apical epithelial CFTR trafficking and transepithelial transport
rationale: Members concern apical protein localization, CFTR trafficking/defects and transepithelial water transport, unlike channel, basolateral secretion and lipid-flippase confusables.

name: Lipoprotein assembly, remodeling, clearance and cholesterol homeostasis
rationale: Members cover chylomicron/VLDL/LDL/HDL assembly, remodeling and clearance with LXR/SREBP sterol control, versus confusables on bile acids and vitamin E.

name: Synapse assembly with glutamate and GABA receptor clustering
rationale: Members concern pre/postsynaptic assembly with PSD-95, NMDA, GABA receptor and gephyrin clustering and excitatory/inhibitory transmission, versus confusables on synaptic adhesion molecules and RPTPs.

qualifier: promoter clearance, pausing and elongation control
name: RNA polymerase II promoter clearance, pausing and elongation control
rationale: Most members regulate Pol II preinitiation, promoter clearance, pausing, elongation and termination, distinct from Pol I/III, RNA processing and HIV-elongation confusables.

name: Peroxide, nitric oxide and sulfide stress responses
rationale: Members are responses to H2O2/hydroperoxide, nitrosative stress, NO, H2S and ischemia with oxidative apoptosis regulation, unlike ferroptosis, respiration and UPRmt confusables.
